title: The fish under the surface at a spot (D139): how a spot's pool is stocked and kept, and what the wizard's looks show

add.description: A pool is stocked with 2d6 plus this many fish.

perDay.description: How many fish drift in each game day, up to the number first rolled.

rollBelow.description: A pool with fewer fish than this is rolled anew.

colourAt.description: From this many looks, Look Underwater shows a fish in its colours; before, as a shadow.

nameAt.description: From this many looks, the player knows what the fish is: the log names it and the journal lists it.

shadows.description: How many of the pool's fish show as shadows under the surface, at most.
